description: There are multiple smartphones available in India that offer high ingress protection ratings. For reference, the OnePlus 15 and OnePlus Nord 6 are claimed to ship with IP66 + IP68 + IP69 + IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance. Similarly, the Oppo F33 Pro 5G offers IP66 + IP68 + IP69 K-rated dust and water resistance. Lastly, the iQOO 15 and the recently launched Motorola Edge 70 Max are claimed to ship with IP68 + IP69 ingress protection ratings for dust and water resistance.
title: Best Water-Resistant Smartphones You Can Buy in India: OnePlus 15, Oppo F33 Pro 5G and More

description: Samsung is scheduled to host its next Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22 in London, UK. The event will begin at 2 pm local time (6:30 pm IST). The South Korean tech giant will livestream the launch event for you via the official Samsung website and Samsung’s YouTube channel. Samsung’s upcoming Galaxy Unpacked event is expected to witness the launch of multiple devices, including smartphones and wearables. Through the teasers, the company has hinted at the arrival of a handset with a wider screen, which is rumoured to be the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, the tech giant’s first wide-folding smartphone.
title: Galaxy Unpacked Roundup: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Series, New Galaxy Watch Models and Everything Else to Expect on July 22

description: iOS 27 Public Beta is finally out for eligible iPhone users. It provides users with an early opportunity to try out all of the new features that Apple previewed at WWDC 2026 in May before they are widely released to the public. Among the notable additions is the new Siri AI experience, which is claimed to be smarter and more proactive than before. There are several other improvements, too, which promise to make everyday iPhone usage noticeably better.
title: Top 5 Features Worth Trying Out on Apple's iOS 27 Public Beta: Siri AI, New Photo Editing Tools and More

description: Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) was a luxury feature reserved for premium headphones and earbuds costing well over Rs. 10,000 just a few years ago. Most such earphones have historically been extremely expensive. But with the advent of time, the technology has trickled down to even budget offerings. Nowadays, you can buy true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds with ANC for less than Rs. 3,000. But does ANC on affordable TWS earbuds actually work, or is it just a marketing gimmick designed to grab attention?
title: Active Noise Cancellation Explained: Does ANC Work on Budget Earbuds?

description: The FIFA World Cup 2026 final will be held on July 20 at 12:30 am IST. The finalists will compete for the world champion’s title at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, New York. You can watch the final on July 20 at 12:30 am IST via the Zee5 app on your smartphone or tablet. Alternatively, you can log in to the Zee5 web portal to watch the FIFA World Cup 2026 final. You can buy Zee5’s FIFA World Cup 2026 + All Access subscription pack at Rs. 399 per month. You can also watch the match via the Zee Unite8 Sports 1, Unite8 Sports 1 HD, Unite8 Sports 2, and Unite8 Sports 2 HD TV channels.
title: How to Watch the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final Live Stream in India

description: Chromebooks and Windows laptops are designed for different needs. While Chromebooks are ideal for web browsing, online learning and everyday productivity, Windows laptops offer broader software compatibility for professional work, gaming and content creation. This guide explains the key differences between ChromeOS and Windows, highlights which platform is better suited to different users and recommends some of the best laptops you can buy in India.
title: Chromebook vs Windows Laptop: Which One Should You Buy in India?
